senses.gloss: [वज् VAJ, be hard or strong].
वज्राय vajrā-ya, den. Ā. become a thunderbolt.

वज्रिन् vajr-ín, a. having the thunderbolt;
 🞄m. ep. of Indra.
वज्रिवस् vajri-vas vc. = vajrin (RV.).
वज्रीभूत vajrī-bhūta, pp. become a thunderbolt.
वज्रेन्द्र vajra‿indra, m. N..

वाजय vājá-ya, den. P., or -yá, P. Ā. race, 🞄contend, vie, speed;
 urge or spur on.

वाजसाति vā́ja-sāti, f. (V.) winning of 🞄booty;
 battle, victory.

वाजीकरण vājī-karaṇa, a. producing virility;
 🞄n. aphrodisiac.
